name: SendChatMessage

parameters.help_en: The message body from the user
parameters.name: content

parameters.help_en: The message type. Valid values: Text and Markdown
parameters.name: content_type

parameters.help_en: The list of digital employee names. A single string can be passed for backward compatibility with the legacy format
parameters.help_zh: 数字员工名称列表（兼容旧格式可传单个字符串）
parameters.name: digital_employee_name

parameters.help_en: The abstract model tier. Valid values: quick, standard, and flagship. If not specified, new sessions use standard, and existing sessions retain the current session tier
parameters.help_zh: 抽象模型档位（quick / standard / flagship）；缺省时新会话用 standard，已有会话沿用会话当前档位
parameters.name: model

fields.help_en: The element type. Valid values: text, web_search, mention, and skill
fields.name: type

parameters.help_en: The list of file references. Each item is an object, and fileId is required (returned by uploadChatFile)
parameters.help_zh: 文件引用列表；每项为对象，fileId 必传（由 uploadChatFile 返回）
parameters.name: files

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable streaming output
parameters.name: stream

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to reuse the most recent session of the digital employee when sessionId is not provided (CLI scenario). Default value: false, which creates a new session
parameters.help_zh: 不传 sessionId 时是否复用该数字员工下最近一个会话（CLI 场景），缺省 false 即新建会话
parameters.name: reuse_last_session

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable direct connection mode. If set to true, the standard scenario routing is skipped and the direct conversation scenario is entered directly
parameters.help_zh: 是否启用直连模式；true 时跳过常规场景路由，直接进入直连对话场景
parameters.name: direct_chat

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable web search. Default value: False. In task execution scenarios (when taskExecution is provided), the task configuration takes precedence
parameters.help_zh: 是否启用联网搜索，默认 False；任务执行场景（传 taskExecution）下以任务配置为准
parameters.name: enable_web_search

parameters.help_en:
The session work mode. Valid values:
ask: Quick Q&A. Tools, skills, and connectors are trimmed, and single-turn direct answers are provided.
work: Deep work. This is the default value.
direct: Direct connection mode (request-level). The sandbox is not started and no context pollution occurs. This is equivalent to directChat=true.

The ask and work modes are session-level: the mode is selected and fixed when a session is created. By default, follow-up messages inherit the session mode. If an explicitly provided value is inconsistent with the session mode, a parameter error is returned. To switch modes, create a new session or fork the existing one. In multi-digital-employee or task execution scenarios, if ask is provided, work takes effect instead. When directChat=true, this parameter is ignored
parameters.help_zh: 会话工作模式：ask=快速问答（裁剪工具/技能/连接器，单轮直答）；work=深度工作（缺省默认）；direct=直连模式（请求级：不启动沙箱、无上下文污染，等同 directChat=true）。ask/work 为会话级：新建会话时选定即固化，续聊缺省继承会话模式，显式传值与会话模式不一致返回参数错误（切换请新建会话或 Fork）；多数字员工或任务执行场景传 ask 时按 work 生效；directChat=true 时本参数被忽略
parameters.name: work_mode

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to enable web search
fields.name: enable_web_search

fields.help_en: The list of associated skill codes
fields.name: skill_codes

fields.help_en: The tenant ID to which the task belongs
fields.name: tenant_id

fields.help_en: The user ID to which the task belongs
fields.name: user_id

parameters.help_en: The task execution metadata returned by executeScheduledTask. When provided, the request is processed through the task execution pipeline
parameters.help_zh: executeScheduledTask 返回的任务执行元数据；传入后按任务执行链路处理
parameters.name: task_execution

data.description_en: The SSE event stream payload. On success, the response is a text/event-stream raw frame that must be consumed frame by frame in streaming mode
data.description_zh: SSE 事件流负载；成功时响应为 text/event-stream 原始帧，需按流式方式逐帧消费

workMode.description_en:
The session work mode that takes effect for the current turn. Valid values:
ask: Quick Q&A.
work: Deep work.
direct: Direct connection (request-level).

In multi-digital-employee or task execution scenarios, if ask is provided, work takes effect instead
workMode.description_zh: 本轮生效的会话工作模式：ask=快速问答 / work=深度工作 / direct=直连（请求级）；多数字员工或任务执行场景传 ask 时按 work 生效
